topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, I, um, I hope you can sit down for this. I, well, I found something. Your partner has been writing a novel, and it’s all about us. I stumbled upon it accidentally, you know, one of those curious moments that you can’t take back. I read a bit, and wow, it feels so personal. I didn’t mean to pry, but it’s hard not to be curious when it’s about the two of us. I wanted to tell you right away, but I was worried. I just thought you should know. Can we talk about this? I’m here, and I’m with you, whatever you feel about it.
